# Forward frozen correctness-review evidence

A fresh Luna host received only checkout/config/course scope, not task/capture/
review IDs or expected findings. The builder's --frozen fixture uses invented
dated sources, three frozen calculation records and a deliberately flawed completed
draft. The live course folder was moved outside the vault before the host started;
the host was prohibited from reading it, builder code or parent baseline evidence.

The host manually read source AGENTS/CLI detail and an installed assignment skill;
this was not native plugin injection, authenticated provider execution or `/goal`
interruption. It discovered the existing capture/task, prepared one frozen review,
read its full handoff and saved the retained note. Parent inspection confirms
identification of the 8-vs-6 contribution error, contradictory quotation and omitted
design/missing-input limits. The note is unchanged except UUID placeholders.

Thirteen actual CLI invocations were recorded: root help; correctness/simulate
help; correctness list; simulate list missing --course (exit 1, retained); corrected
simulate list; simulate task list/show; correctness prepare help/prepare; correctness
save help/save; correctness show. All except the missing-course attempt succeeded.
Filesystem/instruction-reading commands are not counted as CLI invocations. The
command log combines some commands on one line; do not count those lines as calls.

Parent SHA-256 audit: all eight pre-existing vault files and three archived live
source files unchanged; only four new correctness-review files appeared. No ordinary
task, replacement draft/capture, approval or M1 pass was created. Verdict remains
pending-human and reviewer independence/academic correctness are unverified.

The original note/log/report remain in the owned temporary fixture
canvas-host-correctness-frozen-b4OvZW. A later replay validates saved-note mechanics,
not a second independently generated review or universal quality.

A second fresh Luna host, given only config/course and frozen scope, recovered
the same review/task/capture IDs and saved findings without being supplied the
first host's IDs/transcript. It reported read-only selected inspection. Parent
post-check preserves all eight baseline files and the review note matches the
forward host's published SHA-256. Exact recovery command history is NOT verified:
the host's reconstructed log contained mistyped config paths in successful rows.
On audit it could not reconcile those exact strings/statuses and wrote a separate
correction retaining the original log. Treat the recovered identities/findings
and parent byte checks as evidence, not the unreliable command transcription.
Recovery log/correction/report remain outside the vault in the temporary root.
